extensionName.message: Audio Tab Finder – Encontre, Silencie e Feche Abas com Som

extensionDescription.message: Encontre instantaneamente qual aba esta tocando som. Pule para ela, silencie ou feche com um clique. Chega de procurar abas barulhentas.

emptyStateMessage.message: Nenhuma aba tocando audio neste perfil
emptyStateMessage.description: Message shown when no tabs are playing audio in the current profile

noAudioAnywhere.message: Nenhuma aba tocando audio em nenhum perfil
noAudioAnywhere.description: Message shown when no profiles have audio (cross-profile)

thisProfileSilent.description: Subtle line shown above 'Other profiles' section when own profile has no audio

actionFailedToast.message: Acao falhou. O outro perfil pode estar offline.
actionFailedToast.description: Toast shown when a cross-profile action fails or times out

profileLabelEmpty.description: Placeholder shown in profile header when no label is set

profileLabelEditAria.description: ARIA label for the profile header click-to-edit affordance

profileLabelInputAria.description: ARIA label for the profile name input in edit mode

profileLabelSave.description: ARIA label for save icon in profile name edit mode

thisProfileSuffix.description: Suffix shown next to own profile label in popup

muteOthers.description: Tooltip for the solo button on a tab row

muteAllThisProfile.message: Silenciar todas as abas deste perfil
muteAllThisProfile.description: Tooltip for mute-all on the current profile's header

unmuteAllThisProfile.message: Ativar som de todas as abas deste perfil
unmuteAllThisProfile.description: Tooltip for unmute-all on the current profile's header

allProfilesLabel.description: Small label next to the global mute/unmute pair by the popup title

muteAllEverywhere.message: Silenciar todas as abas em todos os perfis
muteAllEverywhere.description: Tooltip for the global mute-all button next to the popup title

unmuteAllEverywhere.message: Ativar som de todas as abas em todos os perfis
unmuteAllEverywhere.description: Tooltip for the global unmute-all button next to the popup title

muteAllThisWindow.message: Silenciar todas as abas desta janela
muteAllThisWindow.description: Tooltip for mute-all on the 'This window' group header

unmuteAllThisWindow.message: Ativar som de todas as abas desta janela
unmuteAllThisWindow.description: Tooltip for unmute-all on the 'This window' group header

muteAllOtherWindows.message: Silenciar todas as abas das outras janelas
muteAllOtherWindows.description: Tooltip for mute-all on the 'Other windows' group header

unmuteAllOtherWindows.message: Ativar som de todas as abas das outras janelas
unmuteAllOtherWindows.description: Tooltip for unmute-all on the 'Other windows' group header

muteAllInProfile.description: Tooltip for mute-all on another profile's heading

unmuteAllInProfile.message: Ativar som de todas as abas em $PROFILE$
unmuteAllInProfile.description: Tooltip for unmute-all on another profile's heading

thisWindowHeader.description: Header for the group of audio tabs in the window the popup was opened from

otherWindowsHeader.description: Header for the group of audio tabs in this profile's other windows

nothingToMuteToast.description: Toast shown when a mute-all found no tab to act on

nothingToUnmuteToast.description: Toast shown when an unmute-all found no tab to act on

volumeLabel.description: Tooltip for the button that opens a tab's volume slider

volumeAria.description: ARIA label for the per-tab volume slider

volumeUnavailable.message: Controle de volume nao disponivel nesta aba
volumeUnavailable.description: Shown when the tab has no media element the extension can reach

volumePermissionBody.message: O controle de volume precisa de permissao para ajustar a midia da pagina.
volumePermissionBody.description: Explanation shown before requesting the optional permission for volume control

volumePermissionButton.description: Button that triggers the optional permission request for volume control

switchToTab.description: Tooltip for clicking on a tab item

untitled.description: Fallback title for tabs without a title

audioPlaying.description: Screen reader text for audio indicator

audioMuted.description: Screen reader text for muted audio indicator

hostBannerExplanationMissing.description: Expanded explanation in the popup banner when host is not installed

hostBannerExplanationOutdated.message: Uma versao mais recente do helper nativo esta disponivel. Atualize para manter as features cross-profile funcionando bem.
hostBannerExplanationOutdated.description: Expanded explanation in the popup banner when host is outdated

hostBannerLinkInstall.description: Link in the popup banner pointing to install instructions

hostBannerLinkUpdate.description: Link in the popup banner pointing to the latest release

hostBannerQuestionMissing.description: Question shown in the collapsed popup banner when host is missing

hostBannerQuestionOutdated.description: Question shown in the collapsed popup banner when host is outdated

supportButtonAria.message: Apoie o desenvolvedor - Me pague um cafe (abre em nova aba)
supportButtonAria.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the Buy Me a Coffee button in the popup footer

supportMessage.description: Short prompt shown above the Buy Me a Coffee button in the popup footer

supportDismissAria.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the dismiss button of the support footer
